definitions.bottom: Lowest-weight 1/2/3 of the selected routed experts; actual weights sorted, shared excluded.
definitions.threshold: Strictly less than 3/5/7/9 percent; all_total applies to the sum of all misses.
definitions.partial_each: Skip only misses in bottom-N with each weight below threshold; other misses still compute.
definitions.all_each: Skip all misses only if every miss is in bottom-N and each weight is below threshold.
definitions.all_total: Skip all misses only if every miss is in bottom-N and total miss weight is below threshold.
definitions.probabilities: Conditional proportions over recorded layer snapshots or selected expert events, not independent trials.
definitions.errors: Fired-only frozen-input local relative L2. Concatenated four-stream hidden, FFN and worst stream separately.
definitions.normalization: Rescale surviving routed mass to the original total; leave shared expert unchanged.

limitations: Frozen-input local omissions only; no logits, task scores or recurrent-state rollout.
Capture changes synchronization and cache timing; these are not latency benchmarks.
Quantiles are descriptive; tokens/layers from one run are correlated, not independent trials.
Weights are actual kernel mixture coefficients; no survivor renormalization.
runtime_caveat: Ordinary paged reference recording, not GPU-resident autonomous decode. No speed or downstream-quality measurement.
